title: Parity mapping, version 0
description: How a legacy golden output compares with a lakehouse table for one custodian: which golden capture output is the oracle, which lakehouse table it compares against, the keys that join a legacy row to a lakehouse row, and the fields compared with their tolerances.

output.description: Name of the golden capture output (legacy.outputs key in capture.yaml) that is the oracle.

custodian_column.description: Column naming the custodian, filtered to this parity mapping's custodian.

business_date_column.description: Column naming the business date, filtered to the date being compared.

keys.description: Columns that identify a row on both sides; a row is compared by matching every key.

fields.description: Columns compared for value parity, each with its own tolerance.

legacy.description: Column name in the legacy output CSV (the golden capture query's own column names).

lakehouse.description: Column name in the lakehouse table.

places.description: decimal_places: round both values to this many places before comparing.

epsilon.description: absolute: the largest allowed difference. relative: the largest allowed difference as a fraction of the larger magnitude.
